Qin's appendix prints the 17-item initial form in a variant wording (观看短视频 for 玩短视频; item 4 adds 担心; item 8 has DIFFERENT content, 'open the video app first thing after not using the phone'; item 12 lacks 空闲时; items 13/14 add 用手机). Table 1 was chosen because Wu's own English of item 8 ('out of mobile signal range ... missing out on some exciting short videos') matches Table 1, not the appendix. option_text is the appendix grid's five anchors 非常不符合/不太符合/不确定/比较符合/非常符合 for 1..5; Qin's methods text names the endpoints differently (完全不符 .. 完全符合, scored 1 and 5), and Wu prints no anchors, so the middle labels are from the 17-item form. instructions left blank: Wu (online, WJX) printed none, and Qin's appendix instruction belongs to the paper 17-item pilot form. MAPPING (reconstructed): D codes are bare source columns with no labels, so the tie to Qin's items was rebuilt from the data.
